_readme: One-wallet funding plan. The person sends everything to the deployer; `fund a:distribute --network <n>` writes wave/distribute-<n>.sh, which tops up donatehot (treat float + gas) and the x402 agent (demo amount + gas) from the deployer keystore, and `fund a:mainnet-plan --network <n>` writes the run-order wrapper. Amounts are decimal strings in whole units (native coin: 18 decimals; tokens: the token's own decimals). `deployer` is not a transfer: it is what the deployer keeps for its own deploys, proof payouts and the Tempo campaign memo, counted in the wrapper's first balance check. Recipients come only from wallets.public.json for the network. Top-up semantics: a recipient already at its target is skipped. Tempo has no gas coin (fees in a USD stablecoin): every amount there is a token. Arc's native coin is USDC (18 decimals, one balance with the 6-decimal ERC-20 interface), so Arc is funded natively only.

mainnet._profile: MINIMAL (default since 2026-10-05): just enough to deploy every contract the submissions reference and to send one real 0.1-token proof payout per instance (PROOF_AMOUNT=100000), plus a 0.1-token treat float (10 treats) and gas for about 10 txs on the hot wallet, and a 0.1 USDC Arc agent float. Exception since 2026-10-07 (Colosseum entered: Tempo, Arbitrum, Base and Robinhood tracks; judging runs until Dec 5, Arc decides by Oct 21): the hot wallet on Arc and Tempo holds about 300 treats so the sponsored-treat demo keeps working through judging. Arc: 3 USDC float + 300 x ~0.0045 USDC treat gas (numbers file 0.0075/treat at 2.5x, x 0.6) = ~4.35, set to 4.45 so the Arc send-to-deployer is a round 5 USDC. Tempo: 3 USDC.e float (exact, unbuffered) + 300 x ~0.00027 pathUSD fees (0.00045/treat at 2.5x, x 0.6) = ~0.081, rounded up to 0.1 pathUSD (unchanged); Tempo USDC.e is token-only, so its send stays exact at 3.2 (3 float + 0.1 proof + 0.1 memo). Every other chain keeps the 10-treat float. Gas is funding-plan.numbers.json (2.5x buffer) x 0.6 = 1.5x buffer; each chain's send-to-deployer total is then rounded up to one significant figure (1.5 when it starts with 1). Base keeps its 0.0005 ETH OP-stack L1 data-fee allowance; Arbitrum and Robinhood (Orbit) each get 0.0001 ETH for L1 price spikes. Per chain, send-to-deployer = deployer reserve + donatehot + agent targets + gasPerTransfer per transfer, which is exactly the first balance check in wave/mainnet-all.sh. The one-week amounts live in profiles.topup: `PLAN=topup fund a:distribute --network mainnet` (or --plan topup) writes wave/distribute-mainnet-topup.sh, which raises the hot wallet (and adds the Base agent) to them later.

topup._readme: One week of treats (funding-plan.numbers.json: 700 treats per chain, 2.5x gas, 50 relays on router chains) and the Base x402 agent (x402 micro-grant, after Oct 12). Replaces the listed roles of the default plan; the deployer keeps no reserve (nothing left to deploy). Selected with PLAN=topup or --plan topup; writes wave/distribute-mainnet-topup.sh. Top-up semantics: each recipient receives target - balance; its CHECK_ONLY=1 run prints exactly what to send the deployer first.
